fields.title: Calculate a Chain
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Checkout goes through gateway 99.95%, order service 99.9%, database 99.95%, payment provider 99.9%, bonus service 99.5%.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: What is the availability of the chain?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: What is the cheapest thing to change?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: product ≈ 99.2%, about 5.8 hours per month. You cannot promise 99.9%. The cheapest fix is removing the bonus service from the critical path — it is the weakest and least critical: checkout without burning points, accruing them later. This yields ≈99.7%. Next, a payment plan B takes the provider out, yielding ≈99.8%. Rule of thumb: shorten the critical path instead of strengthening every link.
